name: application-email-list-row
title: Email List Row
description: Inbox row with an unread dot, a toggleable star, sender/subject/snippet, a timestamp, and an attachment indicator.
useWhen: Building an email or messaging inbox list where each row needs read state, starring, and a content preview.
You want the attachment indicator visible in the list without opening the message.
The row should be a single large click/tap target linking to the full message.
avoidWhen: The content isn't email-shaped (no sender/subject distinction) — use media-object-row for a more generic content row.
You need bulk selection checkboxes — extend this row with a leading checkbox slot rather than replacing the whole pattern.
There's no read/unread concept — drop the unread dot and treat all rows uniformly.
responsiveBehavior: The row is a fixed max-w-md block that fills its container's available width up to that cap at all breakpoints, truncating long sender/subject/snippet text.
accessibility: The star button uses aria-pressed to expose its toggled state and stops its click from triggering the row's own link navigation.
Read/unread state is shown through both a dot and font-weight changes on sender/subject text, not the dot alone.
The attachment icon is aria-hidden since it's a supplementary visual cue; attachment presence should also be discoverable inside the opened message.

variants.title: Email list row
variants.description: Unread, starred message from Priya Shah with subject, snippet, timestamp, and an attachment indicator.
accessibility: Sender, subject, and snippet remain real selectable text even though visually truncated with an ellipsis.

variants.title: Email list row (Dark)
variants.description: Email list row adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Unread dot, star, and text colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
